title: Heels in the Sand | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* Beach Access: Enjoy Dune Allen Beach or Fort Panic, just a mile away* Gourmet Kitchen: Cook in luxury with marble counters, a 6-burner stove, and stainless steel appliances* 4 Complimentary Bikes: Explore the area with ease using four
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* Beach Access: Enjoy Dune Allen Beach or Fort Panic, just a mile away* Gourmet Kitchen: Cook in luxury with marble counters, a 6-burner stove, and stainless steel appliances* 4 Complimentary Bikes: Explore the area with ease using four provided bicycles* Expansive Front Porches: Unwind on two large front porches, perfect for relaxation and enjoying the coastal breeze* Resort-Style Amenities: Access two pools, including an infinity pool overlooking the Gulf.* Convenient Location: Close to dining and entertainment at Stinky’s Fish Camp, Grand Blvd, and Gulf Place.* Professional Management: Rest assured with 24/7 service for a seamless experience.* This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions.* *Wristbands must be worn at the Pool, Tennis Courts, and Clubhouse. This home allows for 8 wristbands. Guests will be charged $100 for each lost wristband.*Escape to the exquisite charm of Heels in the Sand, an inviting 4-bedroom, 3 bath sanctuary nestled within the exclusive Cypress Dunes community. Step into an airy, open living area adorned with soaring 10-foot ceilings, rich solid wood floors, and an abundance of natural light, mere moments from the tranquil community pool. Indulge your culinary desires in the gourmet kitchen, boasting opulent marble countertops, a deluxe Wolf range, double ovens, and sleek stainless steel appliances. With a sumptuous king bed in the Master Suite, a luxurious queen guest bedroom, a cozy full guest bedroom, and a charming bedroom featuring two twin beds and a day bed, this coastal haven comfortably accommodates up to 8 guests. Revel in spectacular sunsets from the expansive front porch or unwind in the serene ambiance of the screened-in back patio, enveloped by lush natural surroundings. Explore the neighborhood on complimentary bicycles, perfect your serve at the tennis courts, meander through scenic nature trails, or whisk away to the beach to enjoy the sugar sand beaches. Experience the epitome of coastal luxury and relaxation at Heels in the Sand-your idyllic retreat awaits.*We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Along the west of 30A, just east of Miramar Beach, you’ll find the luxury gated community that is Cypress Dunes. Here begins the 18 mile bike path that stretches all the way to Rosemary Beach. You will love neighborhood amenities here that include gulf views from the infinity edged swimming pool (seasonally heated for spring and fall school breaks and the holidays), outdoor fireplace, large hot tub, fitness center, and a second-level sundeck overlooking the Gulf and Coastal Dunes Lake. Stroll along the wooden boardwalk and nature trails, have a picnic on the expansive recreational lawn area or get your game on at the tennis courts. For luxury and convenience, Cypress Dunes truly has something for everyone!Bed Setup:1st Floor:Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed2nd Floor:Master Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: Full BedGuest Bedroom: Two Twin Beds and a DaybedArea Attractions: 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17 mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Seahorse Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 715 feet out from the Topsail Hill Preserve State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Seahorse Reef is at a depth of 13-18 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
